_readme: Copy to secrets.local.json and fill in. secrets.local.json is git-ignored - never commit the real file.
account_password: password the ATS scripts use when a job board requires an account
gmail_app_password: Google app password for SMTP send + inbox monitoring
_imap_comment: Extra mailboxes Phase 6 should read besides Gmail - e.g. the proxy mailbox of a third-party auto-apply service. Test with: python scripts/email_monitor.py --imap-only
